As Sheikh Hasina is Ousted in Bangladesh, A Look Back at Her Career | Flashback with Palki Sharma
Unprecedented protests in Bangladesh have forced Sheikh Hasina to resign as prime minister and flee the country. The tumultuous events mark the end of her 15-year reign, a period marked by economic growth and democratic concerns. Palki Sharma brings you the political journey of Sheikh Hasina on Flashback.
